snippet.title: Wolfenstein RPG | iOS Longplay, Full Game, No Commentary
snippet.description:
Enjoyed the video? 🎮 If you'd like to support the channel and get early access to upcoming videos, consider becoming a member! Click here to join:
🔗 https://www.youtube.com/@LongplayExpress/join

Looking for download links to many of the games featured on this channel? Check out my Facebook page (direct download links can't be shared here due to YouTube's Terms of Service):
🔗 https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61556690003239 

Originally released as a Java ME game in 2008, Wolfenstein RPG was ported to iOS devices in 2009 with updated visuals and sound design to suit the more powerful hardware. Following the recipe from 2005's "Doom RPG", Wolfenstein RPG is a turn-based role-playing game set in the Wolfenstein universe. You play as B.J. Blaszkowicz, captured by the Nazis, with your goal to escape custody and infiltrate Castle Wolfenstein to foil the Nazis plans. The overall visuals and design are based on Wolfenstein 3D but with a more "cartoony" vibe to it, alongside a new take on gameplay with turn-based combat and consistent dialogue and cutscenes adding a deeper level of immersion to the game.
